title: Spec CEL constraint language integration
description: Replace free-form constraint strings with CEL (Common Expression Language) expressions. Define standard function library for game-specific predicates (adjacent, in_check, path_clear, etc.). Predicates are CEL; effects remain structural (movement primitives). Document grammar subset, function signatures, and how CEL expressions appear in game-definition.schema.json. Needs Rust (cel-rust) and Python (cel-python) evaluator integration.
close_reason: CEL integration complete: cel-interpreter in Rust, built-in evaluator in Python, both engines evaluate CEL expressions for end conditions and movement conditions, tic-tac-toe updated to CEL syntax, 27 new tests (7 Rust + 20 Python), all 239 tests passing
